name: test-gardener
description: Makes Claude consolidate tests instead of appending them. After it writes or edits a test file, a note names the test files that already cover the module, the near-duplicates and clones among the tests it just added, and a file past the size guideline; a tests_neighbourhood tool answers the same before tests are written; /tests audit lists the consolidations for the project (clones, near-duplicates, parametrize candidates, oversized files, skips, tests whose module is gone) and suggests executing them; a band above the prompt flags a branch heavy with new tests. Never edits a test, blocks nothing, makes no model calls.

nearDuplicate.title: Near-duplicate similarity
nearDuplicate.description: Two tests whose normalised bodies (literals replaced, comments dropped) share at least this Jaccard similarity of 5-token shingles are near-duplicates; 0.9 and above is a clone.

maxTestsPerFile.title: Tests per file guideline
maxTestsPerFile.description: A test file with more tests than this is called out after a write and in /tests audit, to be split by concern.

bigBranchTests.title: Branch band: new tests
bigBranchTests.description: The band above the prompt shows once the branch adds more tests than this against the default branch.

bigBranchLines.title: Branch band: added test lines
bigBranchLines.description: The band above the prompt shows once the branch adds more lines to test files than this.

modelReview.title: Model review of near-duplicates (not yet)
modelReview.description: Reserved for a model pass that judges the near-duplicates found. Not implemented yet: the setting has no effect, and the mod makes no model calls.
